summary: All ten normal and deleted-built-ins browser flows passed at the audited source state. Each flow started and accepted moves without console or page errors.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] ux-browser-review: The three Phaser 2D flows expose empty accessibility snapshots because the game UI draws in a canvas. The 2D screenshots show gameplay, but canvas semantics remain unavailable to assistive technology. This is pre-existing and outside the built-in replacements.
evidence: HEAD at probe end is 79a8d5c4ebc96cf6695e05bbf9dbe3f41f7a2d88. `git diff --stat 229323c5d822f1dcb480b8e5ccf767c98a6f0c75 79a8d5c4ebc96cf6695e05bbf9dbe3f41f7a2d88 -- src` printed nothing. The only non-measure change is tests/audio-handoff.test.ts, which the demo does not serve.
The probe reports 2 passes, 10 flows reached, and 0 flows with errors. Each flow started and its game state changed after input.

Pass A used the four built-ins normally. Pass B removed structuredClone, Array.prototype.at, Array.prototype.findLastIndex, and Object.hasOwn before page scripts. In-page checks confirmed all four were undefined before and after navigation.
Dragon Flight 2D, Dragon Rider 2D, Spellweavers Run 2D, Spellweavers Run 3D, and the host reader each passed in both modes. Each game flow recorded five or six inputs.
The host-reader flow opened the story reader, opened a glossary entry, toggled translation, started and stopped read-aloud, and marked a sentence. This exercises the lastIndexWhere path.
Every flow recorded empty console_errors and page_errors arrays. The probe summary reports all_clean: true.

Reviewed all ten 1280x800 screenshots. The game screenshots show active game HUDs and play states; the reader screenshots show the story page, vocabulary controls, translation, and recorded-audio controls. These screenshots do not establish visual parity or broader visual quality.

The Phaser 2D accessibility snapshots are empty in both passes. The 3D Spellweavers snapshots contain page text and buttons. The reader snapshots expose headings, story text, vocabulary buttons, and reader controls.
The build session reports that the server stopped and port 5199 is not listening. The server log is empty.
The probe ran at HEAD 79a8d5c4 rather than the audited HEAD. The source diff is empty, and the only added non-measure file is a test file that the demo does not serve.
